rule: A seat or pool names a route alias, never a raw model string. The alias fixes provider, launch route and exact model id; the pattern compiler refuses anything not listed here. Free lanes resolve through the semantic router at run time, so the template states the class, not the model.

routeLaws.why: Owner rule 2026-11-04: GPT models run only through fx or pi+SoL-Pi, never inside Hermes chat or delegate_task.
Gemini is reached only through the agy CLI; never as a Hermes provider or direct API.
Free-tier agents go through vLLM Semantic Router lanes so per-model limits and privacy lanes apply.

argon.note: agy is not a harness id in harnesses/catalog.json yet, so the node carries no harness; the route lives in the plan.

free.note: Virtual model. The router picks a qualified free lane per call and logs X-Vsr-Selected-Model.
